messages:
IncBot: [automated] hosted-us-east-1 request queue growth detected. backlog=92,300, p95=1.6s, p99=6.4s, error_rate=4.8%. Autoscaler attempts reporting intermittent creates. Pager -> oncall. Incident ID INC-2026-176950.
Maya: Acknowledged. Starting triage. Who's on infra? Carlos?
Carlos: here. quick glance: autoscaler logs show many create attempts returning 202 then later failing with join errors: 'instance failed to register: network tag mismatch'. Not classic quota. Grabbing exact logs.
Liam: Also seeing surge in incoming RPS from partner key pk_live_XYZ — 2.8x baseline for 18m. Payloads are longer than typical (avg tokens 1200).
Serena: That explains sustained GPU occupancy. Our continuous batching and kv cache means long gens hold GPUs longer.
Nate: Can we temporarily enforce per-request token cap at the gateway? I can push a route override to limit tokens for that partner only.
Samir: Runbook suggests two parallel mitigations: 1) restrict token budget; 2) enable low-latency fallback models for new requests; 3) block rogue integration if necessary.
Carlos: infra detail: the provisioner created instances but they failed to join the serving pool because the new instances didn't have the 'redwood-serving' label due to a recent provisioning script change. Some creates are counted by autoscaler as success but they're unusable. Example log: ```2026-02-09T01:12:05Z provisioner: createInstance id=i-0abc123 status=created tags=[env:prod] expected_tags=[env:prod,redwood-serving] join_status=failed reason=missing_tag:redwood-serving```
Maya: Ok that's different from quota. Rollback that provisioning deploy? Who pushed the tag change?
Carlos: Recent deployment by infra team removed auto-tagging in 2.3.1. Dev-Provisioner, can you hotfix to re-add tag at boot?
Dev-Provisioner: rollback queued. I can patch the init script to add tag and force rejoin. ETA 14m to rollout to new instances.
Oncall-ML: While that rolls, we need immediate capacity. Options: 1) token cap route for partner; 2) divert non-enterprise to eu region; 3) reject long queued requests with 429 or 503 retry-after to free queue.
Nate: I'm pushing a route change to limit tokens to 512 for partner key and set `hard_reject_after_ms=45000` for queued requests. Applying now. Patch: ```PATCH /api/routes/keys/pk_live_XYZ {"max_tokens":512,"queue_hard_reject_ms":45000}```
Nate: Change applied -> verifying metrics.
Serena: Also enable graceful fallbacks: route 30% non-enterprise traffic to rwd-small-quant for new requests only. That will reduce per-token GPU hold time.
Samir: Reminder that fallback invalidates some prefix cache entries. We'll need a background warmup for the quantized model.
Maya: Irene, please prep customer comms for any impacted accounts, especially those with SLOs. Carlos, coordinate infra fix cadence. Liam/Samir monitor queues. Nate, apply traffic rules.
Irene: Drafting message to affected accounts: "We're investigating elevated latencies due to provisioning issue and traffic spike. Mitigations in progress; we'll update in 30m."
Liam: Metrics after token cap and fallback: backlog down to 60k, p95=1.1s, p99=4.3s. But still many instances exist in cloud console in provisioning pending state (not joined).
Infra-Bot: Provisioner summary: creates_attempted=42, creates_successful=28, joins_failed=14, reason_top=missing_tag:redwood-serving.
Carlos: Rolling hotfix now to init script. Will force re-provision of affected instances after patch. Dev-Provisioner: please coordinate draining before restart.
Dev-Provisioner: Hotfix deployed to bootstrap image. Scheduling restart for pending instances only. Doing a small batch to avoid causing extra churn.
Oncall-ML: While infra fixes, consider moving low-priority experimental tenants to ap-south-1 to free us-east GPUs. Any objections?
Maya: Approve non-SLA traffic shift. Nate, implement.
Nate: Traffic rule: route=non_sla -> region_fallback=ap-south-1. Deployed. Traffic shift ~18%. Observed p95 improvement on us-east to 0.85s.
Samir: Warmup task started for rwd-small-quant; issuing synthetic short prompts to warm KV cache. Warmup progress: 20% complete.
Irene: Customers notified, two replies asking about data residency — routing to ap-south-1 is only for non-SLA so no change for enterprise customers.
Liam: Cloud console shows many instances 'running' but missing tag until restart. After hotfix patch, new instances should include tag and auto-join. We'll watch join rate.
Carlos: First batch of patched instances rejoined successfully. join_success_count=8. backlog decreased to 37k.
Maya: Good. Keep hotfix rolling. Also open a Cloud support ticket to double-check any residual networking side-effects.
Dev-Provisioner: Rolling restarts for pending instances ongoing. Estimated completion 28m.
Serena: Observing degraded request tailing: older requests are still hitting 504s. Implementing short-circuit for queued_requests>30s -> immediate 503 with `Retry-After: 10` to avoid clogging.
Nate: Patch applied. Clients will see 503s for very old queued requests.
Samir: Note for postmortem: autoscaler misinterpreting create_success when actual join fails — we should add an immediate join verification before counting capacity.
Oncall-ML: Agreed. Also add alert for join_failure_rate > 2% over 5m.
Maya: Infra-Bot, produce current state summary.
Infra-Bot: State @1769511999: backlog=22,400; p95=0.62s; p99=1.9s; join_failures=14->2 in last 10m; create_attempts=58; active_gpus=420; pending_instances=6.
Irene: Customer update sent: "We've applied mitigations: token caps, regional fallback for non-sla, and a provisioning hotfix. Services are recovering. We'll follow up with RCA."
Carlos: Hotfix completed. All previously pending instances rejoined. join_failures now 0 in last 5m.
Liam: Traffic normalized to 1.05x baseline after partner throttling. Backlog steadily dropping.
Maya: Great. Let's prepare handoff: Serena will own continued monitoring for the next 2 hours, Oncall-ML stays for 30m overlap then hand to regular night oncall. Samir draft postmortem. Carlos implement join verification change to autoscaler.
Samir: Adding postmortem items: 1) fix autoscaler to verify join before counting capacity; 2) add metric alert for join_failure_rate; 3) revert provisioning change in next infra minor release; 4) run partner traffic chaos test 3x baseline.
Irene: I'll compile customer impact: affected requests estimate ~14k errors, top impacted accounts list attached to ticket.
Maya: IncBot, mark incident mitigated and record timeline.
IncBot: [automated] incident_state=mitigated, mitigations=[token_cap,regional_fallback,provisioner_hotfix,queued-shortcircuit], incident_id=INC-2026-176950, timeline_recorded=true.
Maya: Closing when p95 stable <0.7s for 30m. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
Infra-Bot: Final snapshot @1769513999: backlog=3,012; p95=0.28s; p99=0.84s; join_failures=0; create_attempts=62. Incident resolved by Maya.
Maya: Resolved. Postmortem assignment: Samir lead, Carlos infra action owner, Nate routing rules doc, Irene customer comms. Good job everyone. :tada:
